name: @pipeworx/mcp-edinet

tools.name: edinet_search_filers
tools.description: Resolve a Japanese company to its EDINET code and securities code from the FSA's official EDINET filer list — the lookup every other EDINET call needs. Searches Japanese name, English name, kana, EDINET code and ticker across ~11,000 filers, and returns industry, listing status, fiscal year end and corporate number. Needs no API key. Example: edinet_search_filers({ query: "Toyota" }) → E02144 / 7203.

query.description: Company name in Japanese or English, an EDINET code (E02144), or a securities code / ticker (7203).

listed_only.description: Only return exchange-listed filers (上場). Default false.

tools.name: edinet_list_filings
tools.description: Every disclosure document filed with EDINET on one day — annual and quarterly securities reports, extraordinary reports, large-shareholding reports, tender offers — with filer, document type, period and which formats (XBRL / PDF / CSV / English) exist. Optionally filter to one filer or document type. Requires a free EDINET Subscription-Key via _apiKey. Example: edinet_list_filings({ date: "2026-09-11", limit: 20 }).

date.description: Filing date (JST) as YYYY-MM-DD. EDINET keeps the last 10 years.

sec_code.description: Keep only this securities code / ticker, e.g. "7203".

doc_type_code.description: Keep only this EDINET document-type code, e.g. "120" (annual securities report).

xbrl_only.description: Keep only filings that have XBRL. Default false.

tools.name: edinet_company_filings
tools.description: All EDINET filings by one Japanese company over a date range of up to 31 days, newest first. EDINET has no company-search endpoint, so this walks the daily filing lists and keeps that filer's rows. Identify the company with edinet_search_filers first. Requires a free EDINET Subscription-Key via _apiKey. Example: edinet_company_filings({ edinet_code: "E02144", from: "2026-06-01", to: "2026-06-30" }).

edinet_code.description: EDINET code of the filer, e.g. "E02144" (Toyota).

sec_code.description: Securities code / ticker instead of an EDINET code, e.g. "7203".

to.description: End date (JST) as YYYY-MM-DD, at most 31 days after `from`.

tools.name: edinet_financials
tools.description: Reported annual financials of a Japanese listed company from its EDINET annual securities report: net sales, operating income, net income attributable to owners of the parent, total assets, net assets, with fiscal period, accounting standard (J-GAAP / IFRS / US GAAP), the filing document id, and margins. Each amount states its currency and unit and is the full-fiscal-year figure as filed; an amount whose unit cannot be established is returned unresolved, never guessed. A filer without structured data returns found:false. Requires a free EDINET Subscription-Key via _apiKey. Example: edinet_financials({ sec_code: "8035" }).

fiscal_year.description: Calendar year in which the fiscal year ends (March 2026 year end = 2026). Default: the latest filed.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-edinet forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the edinet pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
